{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the highest sample_seq
# Sort by patient_id and sample_seq (descending)
df_sorted = df.sort_values(by=['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False])

# Drop duplicates on patient_id, keeping the first (highest sample_seq)
df_dedup = df_sorted.drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Filter to treatment arm only
df_treatment = df_dedup[df_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Compute fraction who responded
fraction_responded = df_treatment['responded'].mean()

# Confirm the fraction is between 0 and 1
assert 0 <= fraction_responded <= 1, "Fraction responded is not in [0,1]"

# Return the result
fraction_responded"}
